prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1406; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim file purposes. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the accident, so my name is [claimant name].

Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Pearland?

A: I was heading east through the intersection on a green light. I was going maybe thirty-five miles an hour. Out of nowhere, a pickup coming from the north ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced to my left when I entered the intersection, but I didn't see it until it was already on top of me. There was no time to brake or swerve.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbag on my side did deploy, and the belt held me in place.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or get medical attention after the accident?

A: The paramedics checked me at the scene, and then I went to urgent care later that same day. They said I had a neck strain and gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and some anti-inflammatories.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is still stiff, especially in the mornings. Turning my head to the right hurts, and I get a dull headache by the end of the day. I'm going to physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I missed about three days right after the accident. Since then I've been working, but I have to take breaks because sitting at my desk aggravates it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident or your injuries?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure the other driver's version gets checked against the traffic camera footage, because I'm confident about the light.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
